jobs.occupation: Repair and design certification engineer (m/f) -  working on 7/7  shift pattern (h/f) (H/F)
jobs.description: Job Description: Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for an Engineer in Certification and airworthiness (f/m) to join our Design and Repair certification department based in Toulouse, France.You will be part of a team providing airworthiness approval to In-Service repair solutions . As part of the Certification team , you will be involved with Customer Care Center matters to give the best repair solution to the customers for them to bring back their aircraft in an airworthy condition after an event. Your working environment:Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities! How we care for you:Financial rewards: Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis. Work / Life Balance:   Extra days-off for special occasions, holiday transfer option, a Staff council offering many social, cultural and sport activities and other services. Wellbeing / Health: Complementary health insurance coverage (disability, invalidity, death). Depending on the site: health services center, concierge services, gym, carpooling application. Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects  with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, expert career path, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility. At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly.     Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking. Your challenges:We are in close collaboration with all Airbus design offices worldwide.  We are working together with two other off-shore teams, in a follow the sun approach :  one based in Mobile (USA)  one based in Bangalore (India) The work will be performed 7 days a week (monday to sunday) in shifts on day time hours by rotation.  Your main tasks and responsibilities are: Provide Airworthiness approval of in-service repair solutions supported by the Repair and Design Approval Form (RDAF), and Flight Condition Documents (FCD).   Interface with Airbus customer services, design offices, chief engineer teams and the other airworthiness departments.   Act on request as airworthiness specialists in a multifunctional team to solve Aircraft on Ground situations (AOG).  This position is an opportunity to work for all Airbus civil programs, on all ATA chapters and develop multi-skills.  Being part of a very dynamic team, you will acquire a high level of overall aircraft knowledge, and enlarge your network within the company. After the initial training period, the work will be performed seven days a week (Monday to Sunday) in shifts on daytime hours by rotation. Your boarding pass:You have an advanced level in English.  You are educated to degree level (or equivalent) in Engineering or a related discipline. You have structure and systems skills.  You have a good general knowledge in aeronautics.  You have experience in the design office and/or in airworthiness. Knowledge in configuration management is a plus.  You are a real collaborative team player, reactive and curious. This position requires a security clearance or will require being eligible for clearance by the recognized authorities.  Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.  Take your career to a new level and apply online now! -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------Airbus Commercial Aircraft recherche un Ingénieur en certification et navigabilité   (f/h) pour rejoindre notre Service de certification des réparations basé à Toulouse, France . Vous ferez partie d'une équipe qui approuve les solutions de réparations proposées par le bureau d'études du Service Client, suite à un événement en service . Au sein de l'équipe certification et navigabilité, vous aurez la responsabilité de vérifier et attester que la solution technique ainsi appliquée restaure la navigabilité de l'avion. Cette étape est indispensable pour la remise en service de l'avion. Votre environnement de travail :Capitale mondiale de l'aéronautique et capitale européenne de la recherche dans le spatial, Toulouse est une ville dynamique du sud-ouest de la France desservie par un aéroport international. Idéalement située entre la mer Méditerranée et l'océan Atlantique et à proximité des Pyrénées, elle offre de nombreuses possibilités d'activités de plein air ! Parce que nous prenons soin de vous :Avantages financiers : Salaire attractif, accords d'in

Give your career a new dimensionCore mission:The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for fundamental research using neutrons. The ILL operates the brightest neutron source in the world and hosts over 2000 visits by scientists per year, who come to carry out world-class research.Within the Applied Science group (AS, 18 people) of ILL's Science Division, you will act as instrument technician for the new ThRILL thermal neutron imaging instrument, which will enter user operation in 2027, and TENIS, an irradiation instrument serving academic and industrial needs.Your tasks:In this context, you will:- Ensure the smooth operation and maintenance of ThRILL and TENIS, which are located in building ILL5, level C, at the reactor neutron source.- Coordinate the work of ILL services involved in these activities.- Assist the ILL scientists responsible for ThRILL and TENIS with the preparation and conducting of experiments, typically together with scientific and industrial users.- Propose technical improvements and, where appropriate, implement these improvements with the assistance of ILL services.-Help to ensure compliance with ILL and instrument safety regulations, in particular radiation protection regulations.-Become a valued member of the Applied Science group and support your colleagues and users where needed and appropriate.Your profile:- You have a Level 4-6 qualification (e.g. BTEC HNC/HND, undergraduate degree or equivalent) in mechanical engineering, applied physics and instrumentation or equivalent.-You have at least two years of professional experience in the same area.-You have experience in the manufacture, assembly and alignment of precision mechanical, electronic and optical assemblies.-You are proficient in the use of CAD software.-Ideally, you also have some knowledge of computing, electronics and electricity to allow you to take part in other technical projects.-You have a practical approach to your work and are keen to learn new skills.-You are an excellent team player but are also capable of working independently on a wide variety of projects.- You are able to work meticulously and provide support to in-house and visiting scientists.What we offer:Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For this post, medical fitness for work under ionising radiation is required.We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL) is based in Grenoble (France) and operates Europe's leadingresearch facility for basic research with neutrons. United by our passion for progress andtechnology, we drive science and research forward every day.
